messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: p99 spike detected on /v1/stream for model lighthouse-v2 — 00:03 over SLO. Started 2026-03-15T09:12:01Z. Auto-page -> @Ilya (oncall).

Ilya (oncall): picking this up. Any recent rollout activity?

Sam H: yes — autocalib finished a profile update ~09:09 and pushed a canary at 20%. Telemetry shows immediate p99 jump.

Maya K: confirmed. Canary=20% applied at 09:09:08Z. Real-time traces show many stalls in streaming path around token index ~2k.

Omar: infra signals show repeated logs: `kvcache: dequant_lock contention` and `worker: slow-dequant fallback` on a subset of int8 workers. Node kernel queues also higher.

Sam H: matching logs in prod: `streaming: stall waiting on kv-read` and `quant: buf-align mismatch` correlation.

Ilya (oncall): initial customer impact — a few large customers in EU report stalled transcripts and timeouts (~180-240s). Priya, what are CS reports?

Priya (CS): got two high-priority tickets from EU enterprise accounts complaining about long streaming delays and partial transcripts. Marked P1 and routing to SRE.

Maya K: hypothesis: new int8 calibration changed alignment in quant kernels; combined with KV cache eviction pattern for long contexts this causes dequant fast-path to fail and fall back to slower code path, increasing tail latency.

Omar: triage actions recommended: 1) rollback canary to 0%, 2) scale fp16/fallback pool, 3) rewarm KV caches on affected shards, 4) drain suspect int8 hosts.

Ilya (oncall): can we rollback quickly? What's the control-plane call?

DeployBot: Rollback API available. Example: `curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/models/lighthouse-v2/rollouts -d '{"canary":0}' --auth $TOKEN`

Maya K: issuing rollback now. Executing control-plane rollback -> will propagate to routing in ~10s.

DeployBot: Rollback applied. New rollout state: canary=0 (applied 09:14:03Z).

Sam H: routing confirms fallback to previous fp16 profile for affected shards. Initiating slow drain of int8 canary workers.

Omar: scaling fp16 pool +30% to absorb pending streams: `kubectl scale deployment inference-fp16 --replicas=13 -n prod` (started). Also removing two suspect int8 hosts from LB for inspection (`node-prod-int8-42`, `node-prod-int8-43`).

Maya K: starting KV rewarm for shards with high eviction rates: `python ops/rewarm_kv.py --model lighthouse-v2 --shards 12,13,14`. Also opened a draft PR to revert the specific buffer alignment change in quant-kernel.

Sam H: p95 back inside SLO; p99 trending down but small tail outliers remain on shard group 12. Monitoring.

Omar: manual inspection on drained hosts shows repeated `dequant: fast-path failed -> slow-path` and elevated page faults during heavy long-context sessions. Memory churn from cache misses is high.

Priya (CS): customer update posted: rollback done, extra capacity added, working on RCA; follow-up with detailed postmortem in 4 hours.

Maya K: planned next steps: revert kernel alignment change in hotfix PR, add long-context integration tests, run staged canary with stricter ramp (5% -> 10% -> 25%) and p99 gating, and hard-disable auto-calib for lighthouse-v2 until we validate.

Ilya (oncall): I've toggled control-plane flag: `auto-calib: false` for lighthouse-v2. DeployBot confirmed flag update at 09:18:12Z.

DeployBot: config flag updated: auto-calib disabled for lighthouse-v2 (applied 09:18:12Z).

Sam H: filed incident ticket INC-20260315-84 with timeline, attached traces and kernels. Assigned to Maya K for RCA.

Maya K: will run targeted canary in staging with long-context load after hotfix. Also plan to instrument dequant paths to emit metrics on fast-path vs fallback counts.

Omar: keeping drained hosts offline for forensic logs. Rewarm job progress shows steady cache fill; hoping p99 normalizes after rewarm.

Ilya (oncall): handing off to runtime-eng (Maya/Omar/Sam) for root cause and fix. I'll remain available for customer escalations.

Priya (CS): will send customers an interim update in ~30m with status. Final RCA ETA 4h.

IncidentBot: monitoring continues. If new stalls appear, page oncall.

Ilya (oncall): closing immediate paging loop for now — staying in channel until handoff completes. :white_check_mark:

Sam H: :thumbsup:
